title: Rerun-on-approval must treat TIMED_OUT and STARTUP_FAILURE as failures, using one predicate for eligibility and duration
answers: approval rerun reruns slow sibling jobs even though only one job failed fast
why does the rerun workflow rerun a timed-out job after approval
rerun-workflow-run only checks FAILURE conclusions, what about TIMED_OUT
startup failure not triggering or blocking the rerun of failed workflow
body:
Symptom: after approval, the rerun workflow rereruns a slow sibling job when only one job failed quickly, so the slow job's time is wasted.
Root cause: .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml jq filter selected only conclusion == "FAILURE", so a fast FAILURE plus a slow TIMED_OUT job passed eligibility and `gh run rerun --failed` reran the slow sibling.
Fix pattern: define one `failed` predicate (FAILURE, TIMED_OUT, STARTUP_FAILURE) and use it both for the "at least one failure" check and for the duration check over every non-skipped job.
Constraints: SKIPPED jobs are ignored by the duration check; the Protect job is exempt from the 60-second limit; a slow timed-out or startup-failed sibling must block the rerun.
The same three conclusions are treated as failures by retry.sh, so keep the sets aligned if either changes.
applies: Edits to the rerun-on-approval eligibility logic in the GitHub Actions workflow.
says: Approving a rerun triggers lengthy sibling tasks instead of only the fast failure.
Approval reruns restart slow jobs when another task in the build timed out.
Initial startup errors in CI jobs are not recognized when triggering approval retries.
Prevent approval retries from wasting time rerunning long jobs after timeout failures.
Treat pipeline timeouts and startup aborts as failed runs during approval reruns.
search: GitHub Actions rerun-on-approval logic in .github/workflows/retry.sh must unify FAILURE, TIMED_OUT, and STARTUP_FAILURE under a single failed predicate for both eligibility and duration checks. This prevents .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml and gh run rerun --failed from rerunning slow sibling jobs when a fast failure accompanies a slow timed-out job. Applies to workflow rerun-on-approval eligibility edits: SKIPPED jobs are omitted from duration checks, the Protect job bypasses the 60-second limit, and retry.sh failure sets must remain aligned.
